svg.title: How Deephaven works: your code goes to the Java engine, which compiles formulas and reads columns in chunks; each table is a recipe, not a data copy; live results reach every client. When source data changes, most operations recompute only what changed. Six key concepts: formulas run in Java, operations return new tables, order is not guaranteed, static vs live tables, copying data out makes a snapshot, and memory is shared.
